steps: Shred the green cabbage and red cabbage finely using a chef’s knife, mandoline, or food processor shredding blade.
In a very large bowl, toss together the shredded cabbage, shredded carrots, and chopped cilantro.
Whisk the lime juice and neutral oil together in a bowl or measuring cup, then whisk in the sugar.
Toss the dressing with the slaw and season generously with kosher salt and freshly ground pepper.
Serve cold. Best within 1–2 days, though it can be refrigerated for up to 3 days or until it loses its crispness.
